description: Keep the top N rows per group, sorted by a value column. Equivalent to SQL ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ... ORDER BY ... DESC) <= N.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset providing a DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source` -- set exactly one.

source.label: Source
source.description: Pull rows directly via SQL instead of from an upstream asset: {kind: warehouse_query, resource_key: <registered resource> OR database_url_env_var: <env var>, sql: <query>}. Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key` -- set exactly one.

sort_by.label: Sort By
sort_by.description: Column used to rank within each group

n.label: N
n.description: How many rows to keep per group

ascending.label: Ascending
ascending.description: false = top N (default), true = bottom N

rank_column.label: Rank Column
rank_column.description: If set, adds a rank column 1..N with this name

sort_method.label: Sort Method
sort_method.description: Tie-break rule for the rank column.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the catalog

freshness_max_lag_minutes.description: Maximum acceptable lag in minutes before the asset is considered stale. Defines a FreshnessPolicy.
freshness_max_lag_minutes.label: Freshness Max Lag (minutes)

freshness_cron.description: Cron schedule string for the freshness policy, e.g. '0 9 * * 1-5' (weekdays at 9am).
freshness_cron.label: Freshness Cron

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on failure. Defines a RetryPolicy when set.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Max Retries

include_preview_metadata.description: Include a preview of the output data in metadata (first 25 rows or a sample) for builder UIs.
include_preview_metadata.label: Include Preview

preview_rows.description: Rows to include in the preview metadata. For long DataFrames (>10x preview_rows), a random sample is used; otherwise head().
preview_rows.label: Preview Rows

backend.label: Backend
backend.description: 'pandas' (default) or 'polars'. Polars runs sort+head per group with the polars engine and returns a polars DataFrame.

partition_type.description: Enable partitioning: 'daily', 'weekly', 'monthly', 'hourly' for time-based; 'static' for a fixed set of values (e.g. customers); 'multi' for date × static (e.g. day × customer). Leave empty for unpartitioned.
partition_type.label: Partition Type

partition_start.description: ISO date string for the first partition, e.g. '2024-01-01'. Required for time-based and multi partition types.
partition_start.label: Partition Start Date

partition_dimensions.description: Multi-axis partition spec: list of {name, type, start, values, dynamic_partition_name} dicts. Overrides flat fields when set.
partition_dimensions.label: Partition Dimensions

partition_values.description: Comma-separated values for static or multi partitioning, e.g. 'acme_corp,globex,initech'. Required for static and multi types.
partition_values.label: Partition Values

partition_static_dim.label: Partition Static Dim
partition_static_dim.description: Dimension name for the static axis in multi-partitioning, e.g. 'customer' or 'region'.

column_lineage.label: Column Lineage
column_lineage.description: Column-level lineage mapping: output column name → list of upstream column names it was derived from, e.g. {'revenue': ['price', 'quantity']}

name: Top N Per Group
